acts.line: A ten o'clock haircut, then the day bends around Mike's surgery up in Portland.
The afternoon stays open while Mike comes out of sedation, soft food and ice and nothing pressing.
The day closes on the IMC research call with Chie in Tokyo and Mike at nine.
